Screenshot of the typed-name confirmation dialog that appears when the user clicks Revert on an older version. Title: "Revert to v1?". Body explains that reverting copies the chosen version's definition into the live state and saves it as a NEW version on top of the history — no version is deleted, every newer version is kept, and the revert can itself be reverted. A note callout reads "This creates a new version equal to v1 and makes it current. Your newer versions stay in the history.". A TextField labeled "Type 'revert to v1' to confirm" is partially filled. The "Revert" button is disabled until the typed text matches; show it in the disabled state. Cancel button on the left. Dimensions: 600x400px.
